import pandas as pd

import numpy as np
import ast
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    df['sum'] = df['list'].apply(np.sum)
    df['mean'] = df['list'].apply(np.mean)
    df['median'] = df['list'].apply(np.median)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(df['median'], bins='auto')
    return df, ax
```
